name: Scroll Story
description: Sections of text scroll past on one side while a panel on the other stays put and changes to match the section in the middle.

props.name: sections
props.type: { title: ReactNode; description: ReactNode; content: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The sections. content fills the sticky panel while its section is the one nearest the middle.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scroll area, as any CSS length.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the scroll area, which can be focused and scrolled with the keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the scroll area. Its background also backs the panel when it sticks to the top on narrow screens.
